rules.name: module-run
rules.about: `python -m X` and `uv run -m X` run module X, a file under a module root.

origin.why: code-graph spike Q09: a shell script ran `uv run python -m <pkg>.gate` and a pipeline ran `uv run -m <pkg>.ingest`; neither graph tool linked the script to the module file

test.text: cd app && uv run -m pkg.tool all

rules.name: template-placeholder
rules.about: A template's {{NAME}}/path names a file under the directory the placeholder stands for.

origin.why: code-graph spike Q09 and Q11: a .md.tmpl ran `python3 {{ENGINE}}/<dir>/<check>.py`; neither graph tool reads templates

rules.name: python-path-join
rules.about: A Python path join of quoted segments, ROOT / "a" / "b.py", names the file a/b.py.

origin.why: code-graph spike Q10: two in-repo invokers of a hook ran it as ROOT / "hooks" / "<hook>.py"; neither graph tool linked them

rules.name: shell-beside
rules.about: A shell script that runs python3 "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/x.py" runs the x.py beside it.

origin.why: code-graph spike Q09: a sourced shell library ran the Python helper beside it through $(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"); neither graph tool linked them
